source_provenance: Starting commit is the baseline. Raw input and in-image SHA256 identify the tested feature source. LF-normalized hashes identify Git content without rewriting Windows runner bytes.

scope.hosts: two trusted Docker-admin maintenance containers; independent rootfs, journal and owner volumes on one PC
scope.availability: manual externally confirmed fencing; no quorum, automatic election, physical-host, power-loss or operator-ceremony crash guarantee
scope.online_services: no Docker socket or offline root/backup-key mounts; executor socket is root-equivalent trusted maintenance access
scope.application: No app/detection/policy/evaluation changes; no AWS, paid models or real account actions
scope.service_hosts: Two independent DinD CA/PG hosts, remote_apply synchronous replication; no combined arbitrary service-host/control-host partition matrix
scope.management: Two separate nine-volume management cells plus two trusted executor journal/owner pairs
scope.operator_recovery: Manual confirmed fencing; operator lock/partial owner installation failures require investigation; no automatic operator-ceremony resume

preliminary_trials_excluded.reason: BuildKit rejected FROM sha256 image ID as a registry reference. Build uses an owned local tag; runtime remains pinned to image ID.
Earlier narrower preflight, superseded by final eight-case preflight
Earlier preflight without unlabelled pinned service exec barrier, superseded

limits: Same physical PC/kernel/parent Docker; no physical host or whole-site HA
Trusted Docker socket is root-equivalent; nonroot/cap-drop does not sandbox it
Two replicas are not quorum; no automatic election or malicious-admin protection
Operator-ceremony crash, ambiguous fencing or partial owner writes require manual investigation
Fault injections are process/container/volume removal, not power-loss fsync proof
No workload SQLite/certificate-volume HA, production SLA/RTO/RPO or independent teammate validation
Prior 35-case/nine-exit transition campaign is historical and not counted as rerun here
